description.en: Placerias hesternus: whole living environment prop. Nominal whole length 1m art setting, no measured fossil claim. Skull based on Pinto2024 Fig1B corrected UCMP137369 composite; downward paired features are broad maxillary caniniform bone projections contiguous with beak, not giant true ivory tusks. NPS page17 whole-body interpretive art supplies barrel body, short neck/tail and stout limbs only. Skin, color, pose and digits artistic.
